title: Using godot editor freezes and displays a black screen
body:

1. Official website version 4.3
2. 4.4 beta3

### Steps to reproduce

When right-clicking or loading certain functions, the screen will go black for a while or become unresponsive for a while，Double click normally to open, but it will also spin and get stuck, waiting for a while

The same goes for not starting the project
